substitutions: Only routine namespace/name and leading/trailing whitespace changed for the three captured routines; body logic is preserved.
auth.uid() reads a locally assigned UUID; no JWT/Auth verification.
campaign_role has only the dm/player labels used in these cases; its full live enum was not captured.
realtime.broadcast_changes writes to a transactional local outbox; no Realtime network delivery.
Local postgres owner is NOLOGIN NOSUPERUSER BYPASSRLS; live inherited monitoring/platform memberships are omitted.
Policy helper definitions are captured; helper EXECUTE ACL was not captured and local defaults do not prove live helper ACL parity.
Only select/insert/update/delete/truncate privileges from the captured table privilege matrix are replayed; unrelated trigger/reference/maintenance grants are not modeled.
